objective: Proof: within one split no free fill exists; within two splits the cheapest growth still reaches the cube at every doubling; any reach limit that allows a grid's fill allows the fill that adds an order to a line.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): under a reach limit of one split no zero-cost fill exists on any base; under two or more the cheapest growth from one knot still reaches Q_d at n = 2^d; no reach limit read from the states separates a grid's cell fill from the fill that adds an order to a line.
title: Reach limits cannot hold two orders
